summary: Baidu, Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return dated September 23, 2026, reporting on-market repurchases of its Class A ordinary shares (HKEX: 09888) for cancellation. Thirteen separate buyback tranches between September 7 and September 23, 2026 totaled roughly 7.26 million shares, each about 0.025% of issued shares, at prices from HKD 86.91 to HKD 92.38 per share. Issued shares remained 2,209,541,178 and no board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The filings confirm repurchased shares are not yet cancelled; watch the pace of continued buybacks and the resulting share-count reduction.
